text: A young lion cub's single grumpy, comical mini-roar in response to someone offering to find his tail: a clear low 'grrr-ROW' with a quick firm onset and rounded finish. Recognizably a lion, small and child-friendly, annoyed rather than scary. Natural animal vocal only; no human words, no meow, no adult attack roar, no distortion, no thunder, no music or ambience.
